nodes.label: Smart Aim Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Velocity lead was removed from the smart pipeline: in a closed loop the assist's own view pan looks like target motion, so lead is broken until ego-motion compensation exists. Tracking aims only at the raw detection (no velocity) so it cannot drift.

nodes.label: Frame-rate-independent Damped Controller
nodes.rationale: A closed-loop controller observes where the target actually is each frame and corrects toward it, so a one-off sensitivity measurement (the old calibration wizard) is no longer needed.
